# fct_marketing_spend_daily

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_marketing_spend_daily` · dbt area: `growth`

Unified daily marketing spend across all paid channels, such as Meta (Facebook), Google (Search and YouTube), TikTok, or Podcasts. Includes channel tier hierarchy, test spend flagging, and date spine logic for distributing monthly manual entries across days. Each row represents the combination of a spend date + country + channel tiers (including adset/ad group level). Sourced from Facebook (Meta) Marketing and Google Ads data streams, plus manual entry Google Sheet.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `marketing_spend_daily_id` | Unique Primary Key assigned to each spend using a surrogate of date, country, and channel tiers (1-4). >> SOURCE - Growth team Google Sheet data_tests: - not_null - unique |
| `campaign_name` | The original (non-lowercased) campaign name from the ad platform. Used for test spend flagging. >> SOURCE - Ad Platform integration; Google Sheets manual entry |
| `channel_tier_0` | The highest level marketing channel (such as 'Paid' or 'Organic') based on the How Did You Hear About Us question in the application. >> SOURCE - Ad Platform integration; Google Sheets manual entry |
| `channel_tier_1` | The first level marketing channel (such as 'Paid Social' or 'Organic Search') based on the How Did You Hear About Us question in the application. >> SOURCE - Ad Platform integration; Google Sheets manual entry |
| `channel_tier_2` | The second level marketing channel (such as 'YouTube' or 'LinkedIn') based on the How Did You Hear About Us question in the application. >> SOURCE - Ad Platform integration; Google Sheets manual entry |
| `channel_tier_3` | The third level marketing channel — lowercased campaign name. >> SOURCE - Ad Platform integration; Google Sheets manual entry |
| `channel_tier_4` | The fourth level marketing channel — lowercased adset name for Meta. Null for Google, YouTube, TikTok, and manual entries. >> SOURCE - Facebook Marketing |
| `last_click_channel_tier_0` | The highest level marketing channel (such as 'Paid' or 'Organic') based on Last Click. >> SOURCE - Ad Platform integration; Google Sheets manual entry |
| `last_click_channel_tier_1` | The first level marketing channel (such as 'Paid Social' or 'Organic Search') based on Last Click. >> SOURCE - Ad Platform integration; Google Sheets manual entry |
| `last_click_channel_tier_2` | The second level marketing channel (such as 'YouTube' or 'LinkedIn') based on Last Click. >> SOURCE - Ad Platform integration; Google Sheets manual entry |
| `last_click_channel_tier_3` | The third level marketing channel (lowercased campaign name) based on Last Click. >> SOURCE - Ad Platform integration; Google Sheets manual entry |
| `last_click_channel_tier_4` | The fourth level marketing channel (lowercased adset name) based on Last Click. Only populated for Meta. >> SOURCE - Google Last Click, Facebook Marketing |
| `country_code` | The 2-letter country code for where the spend occured >> SOURCE - Growth team Google Sheet |
| `impressions` | Total number of impressions, where an impression is one instance of a piece of advertising content being shown to a user, regardless of whether they interact with it. >> SOURCE - Facebook & Google Ads |
| `is_test_spend` | Whether the spend is manually categorized as test spend, based channel or campaign, country, and start and end date. >> SOURCE - Growth team Google Sheet |
| `reporting_country_code` | 2-letter ISO country code, from the ad platform or manual spend sheet. >> SOURCE - Ad Platforms (Meta, Google, Etc.); Growth team Google Sheet |
| `reporting_country_name` | Standard country name, based on a lookup against the 'Reporting Country Code' field. >> SOURCE - Google Sheet (managed by International Team) |
| `reporting_region` | Fora-defined international reporting region (e.g. 'LATAM', 'Europe', 'APAC'). Based on a lookup against the 'Reporting Country Code' field. >> SOURCE - Google Sheet (managed by International Team) // Reminder on logic for the Country Code itself -> From the ad platform or manual spend sheet. |
| `spend_date` | The date when we spent the spend. >> SOURCE - Growth team Google Sheet |
| `spend_usd` | The total amount of spend we recorded, in $ USD. >> SOURCE - Growth team Google Sheet |

<!-- END dbt -->

## Notes from analysts

- Filter `is_test_spend = false` (or `coalesce(is_test_spend, false) = false`).
